t: You're looking at One New Change, the big shopping and office development in the City of London. It's the only large shopping centre in the City, the historic heart and modern financial centre of London. There's about 560,000 square feet of floor space here, roughly 220,000 of it retail and 330,000 offices. It cost half a billion pounds and was completed in October 2010. The French architect Jean Nouvel designed it. Nouvel won the Pritzker Prize in 2008, and the Wolf Prize in Arts in 2005, so this is the work of a very well decorated architect.
